abstract_summary: Long-running LLM agents require memory that persists and evolves across sessions. Text-based memory retrieves and reconstructs past interactions at every query, making long-horizon performance increasingly dependent on retrieval quality and contextual reasoning as histories grow. evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Held-out users, topics, and benchmark splits provide objective label-based evaluation, with additional independent general-capability checks on MMLU, GSM8K, and IFEval [E663b9df806f43ebb-B0028, E663b9df806f43ebb-B0041].
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Headline outcomes are accuracy on held-out benchmark partitions: PERMA leave-one-user-out folds, PersonaMem-v2 benchmark split, and PrefEval topic-held-out splits, scored against ground-truth labels [E663b9df806f43ebb-B0028, E663b9df806f43ebb-B0100, E663b9df806f43ebb-B0102].
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: The compiler is trained to match context-conditioned teacher distributions via fixed-reference forward-KL, and the consolidation gate is trained with answer-label cross-entropy on benchmark training partitions [E663b9df806f43ebb-B0020, E663b9df806f43ebb-B0024, E663b9df806f43ebb-B0103].

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Claims regarding superior cross-session tracking, efficiency, and cross-backbone transfer are fully substantiated by consistent empirical improvements across settings, including cross-backbone reuse outperforming training from scratch [E663b9df806f43ebb-B0031, E663b9df806f43ebb-B0038, E663b9df806f43ebb-B0174].
primary.evaluation_assessment: Evaluation covers three long-term memory benchmarks (PERMA, PersonaMem-v2, PrefEval) and five backbones, comparing against strong parametric (Metis-9B, SFT) and textual baselines under strict leave-one-out and official splits [E663b9df806f43ebb-B0028, E663b9df806f43ebb-B0030, E663b9df806f43ebb-B0031]. Extensive ablations on objectives and consolidation variants, along with efficiency profiling and general capability checks (MMLU, GSM8K, IFEval), thoroughly validate performance [E663b9df806f43ebb-B0035, E663b9df806f43ebb-B0040, E663b9df806f43ebb-B0041].

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Standardized objective task evaluations on held-out users, splits, and topics, as well as separate general foundation benchmarks (MMLU, GSM8K, IFEval) [E663b9df806f43ebb-B0028, E663b9df806f43ebb-B0041].
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Accuracy on official benchmark test/held-out partitions (PERMA leave-one-user-out folds, PersonaMem-v2 test split, and PrefEval topic-held-out splits) evaluated via ground-truth answer matching [E663b9df806f43ebb-B0028, E663b9df806f43ebb-B0100, E663b9df806f43ebb-B0102].
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Compiler training optimizes token-level forward-KL divergence against context-conditioned teacher logits on compilation corpora, while consolidation gate training optimizes task cross-entropy on designated benchmark training splits [E663b9df806f43ebb-B0020, E663b9df806f43ebb-B0024, E663b9df806f43ebb-B0103].

primary.limitations: The authors explicitly discuss that consolidation policies are trained on application-specific task data, and their zero-shot transfer across vastly different interaction patterns remains an open question [E663b9df806f43ebb-B0057].
primary.method_assessment: The method is clearly specified: Stage 1 compiles context into fixed-size latent memories using a Perceiver resampler trained with fixed-reference forward-KL distribution matching, and Stage 2 trains a coordinate-wise recurrent gate using task-level supervision while keeping backbone and compiler frozen [E663b9df806f43ebb-B0016, E663b9df806f43ebb-B0020, E663b9df806f43ebb-B0022, E663b9df806f43ebb-B0024]. Target backbone replacement is supported by adapting only the model-specific decoder [E663b9df806f43ebb-B0021, E663b9df806f43ebb-B0038].
primary.quality_rationale: The manuscript presents a rigorously detailed, well-motivated architecture addressing memory lifecycle independence and forward-only updates. Thorough empirical evaluation across multiple models, benchmarks, and ablations provides compelling evidence for all primary claims.
primary.scoped_contribution: The paper introduces RPMem, a two-stage architecture that enables lifecycle-independent parametric memory for LLM agents by compiling interaction sessions into a fixed-shape latent memory and recurrently consolidating them across sessions before decoding into backbone-specific LoRA parameters [E663b9df806f43ebb-B0002, E663b9df806f43ebb-B0010].

Thorough empirical evaluation across multiple models, benchmarks, and ablations provides compelling evidence for all primary claims.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The authors explicitly discuss that consolidation policies are trained on application-specific task data, and their zero-shot transfer across vastly different interaction patterns remains an open question [E663b9df806f43ebb-B0057].
